description: This file defines the Role class within the OpenMRS API, representing user roles and their privileges, inheritance, and hierarchy management.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a user role in OpenMRS, managing privileges, inheritance, and hierarchy relationships.

methods.name: getPrivileges
methods.description: Returns the set of privileges associated with this role.

methods.name: setPrivileges
methods.description: Sets the privileges for this role.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the role.

methods.name: addPrivilege
methods.description: Adds a privilege to this role.

methods.name: containsPrivilege
methods.description: Checks if a privilege with a specific name exists within a collection.

methods.name: removePrivilege
methods.description: Removes a privilege from this role.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role identifier string.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: Sets the role identifier string.

methods.name: hasPrivilege
methods.description: Checks if this role has a specific privilege, directly or via inheritance (if extended).

methods.name: getInheritedRoles
methods.description: Returns the set of roles inherited by this role.

methods.name: setInheritedRoles
methods.description: Sets the inherited roles for this role.

methods.name: inheritsRoles
methods.description: Checks if this role inherits from other roles.

methods.name: getAllParentRoles
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all parent roles of this role.

methods.name: recurseOverParents
methods.description: Recursively collects all ancestor roles, avoiding cycles.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Unsupported; throws exception.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Unsupported; throws exception.

methods.name: getChildRoles
methods.description: Retrieves immediate child roles.

methods.name: setChildRoles
methods.description: Sets the immediate child roles.

methods.name: hasChildRoles
methods.description: Checks if this role has child roles.

methods.name: getAllChildRoles
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all descendant roles.

methods.name: recurseOverChildren
methods.description: Recursively collects all descendant roles, avoiding cycles.
